jp-kansai-p2-kddi-20260807-1q-qa-sakai.summary: KDDI's own written summary of its 7 August 2026 first-quarter results briefing and Q&A. In answering a question on AI growth investment, management states that companies that have already adopted the AIDC's Sakai DC (AIDC の堺 DC で既に採用した企業) include autonomous-driving companies and other diverse use cases, and that investment targets will be chosen with those fields in mind. The AIDC Sakai DC is KDDI's Osaka Sakai Data Center (KDDI's first AI data centre, opened 22 January 2026). The statement describes customers already using the facility at the time of the briefing; it gives no capacity, utilisation, new building or phase.

jp-north-p2-hix-bbt-ishikari-resale-2026.summary: BroadBand Tower and Hokuden Information Technology (Hokkaido Electric group) announce that from 15 October 2026 Hokuden IT resells the data-centre services (colocation, internet lines and related options) that BroadBand Tower provides in its data hall 石狩新港サイト inside 石狩再エネデータセンター第1号 (Ishikari, Hokkaido), a facility characterised by 100% renewable power; the stated service start for the resale is 15 October 2026, for AI/HPC, disaster-recovery and backup use. BroadBand Tower provides the data-centre service and technical support for equipment and operation; Hokuden IT is the sales window. The release names the facility and the hall in the present tense and gives no capacity, occupancy, new building or phase.
jp-north-p2-hix-bbt-ishikari-resale-2026.title: BroadBand Tower and Hokuden Information Technology joint release (15 October 2026): resale of BroadBand Tower data-centre services from its Ishikari Shinko Site hall inside Ishikari Renewable Energy Data Center No.1

status_updates.identity_review: KDDI's AI data-centre business (AIDC) has one Sakai facility: the Osaka Sakai Data Center in the former Sharp Sakai LCD-plant building, opened on 22 January 2026 (KDDI Spark Journal, 22 January 2026, captured by the 14 October lane) and already in the Atlas as site vcc-site-60fde18b993e0affd6b1 with this single project (operational, 2026-07-28, KDDI newsroom release kddi_nr-1103_4632). The Q&A's 'AIDC の堺 DC' therefore names the same facility; it describes the whole existing data centre, not a new phase, so the project scope and its reviewed campus locator stay unchanged. SoftBank's separate Sakai AI data centre on the same former Sharp site is a different operator and record.

status.summary: KDDI's written Q&A summary of its 7 August 2026 first-quarter results briefing states that companies have already adopted the AIDC's Sakai DC, including autonomous-driving companies and other use cases. This is a current-use statement about the existing Osaka Sakai Data Center at the time of the briefing, so the existing operations are refreshed as operational on 7 August 2026. It does not state capacity, utilisation, an opening date or any new building or phase.

status_updates.successor_review: Strictly newer than the existing 28 July 2026 observation. KDDI's IR results-briefing library, captured 23 October 2026 (local kddi-ir-presentation.html), lists no later results event (the second-quarter briefing is announced for 6 November 2026). KDDI's newsroom (newsroom.kddi.com) answered HTTP 403 to this client on 23 October and was not retried, and the Internet Archive holds no 2026 copy of its news index after 1 August (CDX query, local wb-cdx-kddi-news.json), so later releases could not be screened directly. The 5 August consortium release (GPU platform at the Sakai data centre provided to an autonomous-driving consortium) and the 18 September release (a distributed-data-centre demonstration begun in September 2026 that links the Sakai data centre to KDDI's Tama network centre by APN, with no commencement day given), both captured by the 14 October lane, report no pause, closure or change of scope. Neither was used here; 7 August is kept.

status_updates.identity_review: The release names 石狩再エネデータセンター第1号 (北海道石狩市), the facility of the existing project (Ishikari Renewable Energy Data Center No.1, operated by Ishikari Renewable Energy Data Center No.1 LLC, campus parcel locator at 43.178556, 141.298122), and BroadBand Tower's 石狩新港サイト, which the base already records as a data hall inside that facility (BroadBand Tower is the existing project's current tenant claim; the 2026-10-22 thirty-fourth holds reject the hall as a separate site or project). The release's exterior photograph is credited to 合同会社石狩再エネデータセンター1号. Hokuden IT's own H-IX data centre in Sapporo, mentioned as background, is a different facility and is not affected. This is a status refresh of the existing facility-wide project; scope, locator and roles are unchanged.

status.summary: BroadBand Tower and Hokuden Information Technology's joint release of 15 October 2026 states that from that day Hokuden IT sells the data-centre services (colocation, internet lines, related options) that BroadBand Tower provides in its 石狩新港サイト data hall inside Ishikari Renewable Energy Data Center No.1, with a stated service start of 15 October 2026. This confirms the existing facility was in operation on 15 October 2026. It reports no new building, phase, capacity or occupancy, and GMO's planned GPU-cloud deployment in the same hall is not treated as operating.
